results.title: Sheikh Ibrahim Barsha accepts appointment as interim National Imam of ASWAJ, calls for unity
results.content: A founding member of Ahlussunna Wal Jama'a (ASWAJ) and one of Ghana's most respected Islamic scholars, Sheikh Ibrahim Barsha, has accepted appointment as the organization's Interim National Imam.

results.title: Obuasi Beverages CEO donates GH¢120,000 towards 33-year-old man’s brain surgery
results.content: The Chief Executive Officer of Obuasi Beverages Company Limited, Dr Amo Collins, has donated GH¢120,000 towards the emergency brain surgery of 33-year-old Edmond Benefo, who has been diagnosed with a brain tumour. The contribution, equivalent to US$10,000, covers half of the US$20,000 required for Edmond's medical treatment and surgery in India. Edmond's health challenges reportedly began with complaints of eye problems, which progressively worsened before medical examinations revealed a brain tumour requiring urgent surgical intervention.

results.title: Newsfile to discuss Traffitech-GH fines, drug busts and Parliament’s continued absence of Asante Akyem North MP
results.content: This Saturday’s edition of Newsfile on JoyNews will examine three major issues dominating Ghana’s public discourse, as host Samson Lardy Anyenini leads discussions on road safety enforcement, the fight against drug trafficking and developments in Parliament.

results.title: Before buying AI, businesses need to ask better questions
results.content: A recent analysis encouraged Ghanaian entrepreneurs to connect artificial intelligence with practical needs, including customer communication and record-keeping. That is a useful starting point, but it leaves another question: how should a business choose the company providing the technology? A convincing demonstration should begin a discussion, not end it. Before committing money or uploading customer information, owners need to understand what a service delivers, what remains their responsibility, and how they can leave if it disappoints. Request a Demonstration of Your Actual Work Consider a hypothetical printing business in Kumasi comparing two services for preparing quotations. Instead of accepting a supplier's polished examples, the owner could provide a fictional order and an approved price list.

results.title: Mining Reforms Must Protect Jobs, Investment and Community Interests — Ghana Chamber of Mines
results.content: The Ghana Chamber of Mines has called for sustained dialogue and careful consideration of the economic implications of ongoing mining sector reforms, stressing that efforts to deepen Ghanaian participation must also safeguard employment, investment and the industry’s long-term competitiveness.

results.title: COCOBOD relaunches free fertilizer programme with new monitoring platform to boost farmer incomes
results.content: The government has relaunched the Free Fertilizer and Agro-Input Programme for cocoa farmers under a major intervention to restore productivity, improve farmer incomes, and reset the cocoa sector.

results.title: Farmers urged to enroll in insurance policies to protect investments against El Niño impacts
results.content: The recent climatic phenomenon, El Niño, is prompting the urgency for farmers to take immediate steps to seek insurance protection for their investments.

results.title: District Health Information Management System fully restored – Health Ministry
results.content: The Ministry of Health says the District Health Information Management System (DHIMS) has been successfully restored and is now fully operational following a temporary disruption.

results.title: Sheikh Umar Ibrahim Imam removed as National Imam of ASWAJ
results.content: The National Da’awa Council (NADAC) of the Ahlussunna Wal Jama’a (ASWAJ) has officially removed Sheikh Umar Ibrahim Imam from his position as National Imam.

results.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
results.content: A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children.

results.title: Afenyo-Markin pushes for Health Minister’s appearance over shutdown of health information systems over $64m debt
results.content: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin is pushing for the Minister of Health, Kwabena Mintah Akandoh, to appear before the House to explain the shutdown of Ghana’s Health Information Management Systems.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS sexual abuse: The president has been on public platforms multiple times and has never addressed it – Akosua Manu
results.content: The Advisor on Gender and Social Protection to former Vice President Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has criticised President John Mahama for failing to publicly address the alleged sexual abuse of 19 female students at the Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS).

results.title: It was clear gov’t wanted to cover up Obuasi SHTS sexual abuse – Akosua Manu
results.content: The Advisor on Gender and Social Protection to former Vice President Dr Mahamudu Bawumia has accused state institutions of failing to act promptly on the alleged sexual abuse of 19 female students of the Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS).

results.title: Dreams Championship brings back high school rivalry
results.content: The competition, formerly known as Sprite Ball, which focused exclusively on basketball, has been rebranded and expanded to include multiple sporting disciplines in a move organisers say will provide greater opportunities for students to showcase their talents.

results.title: Africa’s events industry urged to embrace sustainable practices beyond PR and publicity at Climate x Culture Summit
results.content: Stakeholders in Africa's creative industry have called for greater commitment to environmentally sustainable practices in event planning and production, warning that the industry must move beyond sustainability claims to deliver measurable action.

results.title: Institute of Packaging Ghana to strengthen collaboration with farmers, agribusinesses to boost packaging industry
results.content: The Institute of Packaging, Ghana (IOPG) says it will deepen collaboration with farmers, agro-processors and other stakeholders in the agricultural value chain to improve packaging solutions, reduce post-harvest losses and enhance the competitiveness of locally produced goods.

results.title: Trump signs order to preserve Oval Office as national monument
results.content: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order that he says will prevent future presidents from making certain changes to the White House Oval Office.

results.title: Over 400 Northern Ashanti Mines workers petition Mahama over mine closure
results.content: More than 400 workers of Northern Ashanti Mines Limited Company (NAMLC) have petitioned President John Mahama to intervene in the closure of the mine and facilitate its reopening following its takeover by the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS).

results.title: Spate of bomb threats poses serious challenge to airline industry
results.content: With no fewer than 32 bomb threats affecting a dozen airlines in the space of four days, the aviation industry is facing another potential crisis.

results.title: Prioritise youth employment – TEIN, TESCON to NDC, NPP
results.content: The Tertiary Education Institutions Network (TEIN) of the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC) and the Tertiary Students' Confederacy Network (TESCON) of the opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP) have appealed to their respective political parties to make youth employment a priority and to complete all projects started by earlier governments when in power.

results.title: Historic private estate goes on sale for £65m
results.content: A mansion once home to lieutenant-governors, a marmalade magnate and family of Oscar-winning actresses has been put on the market for £65m.

results.title: AMA warns of sanctions for non-compliance with November 7 sanitation exercise
results.content: The Accra Metropolitan Assembly (AMA) has warned residents, traders and businesses in the metropolis that individuals found operating during the November edition of the National Sanitation Day exercise or obstructing clean-up activities will face legal sanctions.

results.title: No Bed Syndrome: Mahama announces expansion of accident and emergency centres at four major hospitals
results.content: President John Mahama has announced plans to expand the accident and emergency centers at four major hospitals in the country, with work expected to begin next year.

results.title: Hamile dynamite explosion: FOSDA calls for investigation into explosives movement, border security vulnerability
results.content: The Foundation for Security and Development in Africa (FOSDA) expresses grave concern over the dynamite explosion in Hamile, Lambussie District, in the Upper West Region, on Tuesday, 3 November 2026, which reportedly claimed the lives of a Ghana Immigration Service officer and two civilians, with several others sustaining injuries.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS headmaster has not been cleared of sexual abuse allegations – GES
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) has clarified that the Headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School, Abdulai Zakaria, has not been cleared of allegations of sexual abuse involving female students.

results.title: Apprise Music takes Ghanaian artists to WOMEX 2026 in Spain
results.content: Ghanaian music company Apprise Music & Media has completed its fourth participation in the Worldwide Music Expo, with its latest attendance highlighting efforts to expand international opportunities for Ghanaian musicians and strengthen connections between Africa's music sector and the global live music industry.

results.title: President Mahama hints at multi-day celebrations for Ghana’s 70th independence anniversary
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has mentioned that Ghana’s 70th Independence Anniversary celebrations in 2027 will span several days
